subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation treat both the global browser SSRF opt-in and models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork as authorization to reach private endpoints through the shared configured-request path?
rationale: The code can safely implement either policy, but choosing the permanent authorization scope for a private-network security boundary requires owner intent rather than automation judgment.

options.title: Honor both existing opt-ins
options.body: Match the reported expectation and sibling provider pattern by accepting either explicit browser-wide or xAI provider-request authorization.

options.title: Require provider-specific opt-in
options.body: Allow private xAI image endpoints only through models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork and leave the broader browser policy unrelated.

options.title: Keep xAI image denial
options.body: Retain fail-closed behavior and close the linked request as an unsupported private-network workflow.

recommendation.title: Honor both existing opt-ins
recommendation.body: Match the reported expectation and sibling provider pattern by accepting either explicit browser-wide or xAI provider-request authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the closest provider-side SSRF authorization and redirect-policy precedent.
